title: Code and derived results: When does surface EMG add value for decoding joint kinematics? A causal benchmark on an open upper-limb exoskeleton dataset
description: Code and derived results accompanying the manuscript "When does surface EMG add value for decoding joint kinematics? A causal benchmark on an open upper-limb exoskeleton dataset" (submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control). Causal EMG feature extraction, ridge/LSTM/TCN decoders, all analyses and statistics, and scripts that regenerate all tables, figures and supplementary tables of the paper. Code: MIT licence. Derived results: CC BY-SA 4.0 (licence of the underlying dataset).
